description: npm 12 refuses registry tarballs it must open to read bundled dependencies (npm/cli#9800), so Renovate's lockfile regeneration fails with EALLOWREMOTE on the npm package that @semantic-release/npm pulls in. allow-remote=all applies only to Renovate's --ignore-scripts lockfile runs. Remove npmrc and npmrcMerge once Mend's npm includes the npm/cli#9819 fix.
